name: GPT-5.4 Mini
short: OpenAI's small tier (400K/128K, $0.75/$4.50) for delegated coding and computer use; OSWorld 72.1%, 30% of 5.4 quota in Codex.
standout: The delegation tier: computer-use and coding errands at small-model prices, sized for fleets of subagents under one orchestrator.
tradeoff: A smaller reasoning ceiling — it performs tasks, the 5.4/5.5 flagships architect them.
